confidence_notes: Meal, coffee and beer estimates are informed by [Numbeo](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Florianopolis) and [Wise](https://wise.com/us/cost-of-living/brazil/florianopolis). Cocktail and wine estimates are less certain and use approximate local price relationships to beer. Accommodation estimates are holistic, with substantial variation by location and July holiday demand.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on southern Brazilian urban prices, adjusted for Florianópolis's coastal tourism market and its quieter winter season.
